title: Geometric spaceability in sequence classes and operator ideals
summary: This paper investigates advanced notions of lineability and spaceability within the frameworks of sequence spaces and operator ideals. We propose the notion of \emph{Standard Sequence Classes} to provide an environment that unifies numerous classical sequence spaces while preserving their fundamental behavior. Utilizing this framework, we establish general $(α, \mathfrak{c})$-spaceability results for complements of unions of (quasi-)Banach sequence spaces.
